sdc.daemon.StepInFlight.title: StepInFlight
sdc.daemon.StepInFlight.description: The step of a run whose program is running now: the action the bindings bind to the program, the case it runs for and when it started, the start the event `runbook.action-started` recorded. `seconds` is the time since `started_at` by the daemon's clock, read when the view is read.

action.description: The action whose program (or `handoff_when` check) runs; absent when no single action of the runbook's bindings binds the program.

case_id.description: The case the program runs for; absent when the runtime names none.

started_at.description: The `at` of the event `runbook.action-started` of this step.

seconds.description: Whole seconds from started_at to the moment the view is read, 0 or more.
